The '''japor tree''', also know as '''japor''', was a small [[Tree/Legends|tree]] that grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Its nuts were frequently carved into [[Japor snippet/Legends|japor snippets]] while its [[Japor ivory wood|wood]] was used in luxury furniture.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|140|japor}}</ref>
